title: The Offside Trap (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 104bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal football philosophy
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The offside trap is a collective act of confidence
Eleven men stepping forward at exactly the same moment
Trusting that none of them will flinch
And the forward will be left standing
Where the law says he shouldn't be

[Verse 2]
It only works if everyone believes in it
One man who hesitates
One man who stays back half a second
And the trap becomes a gift
A beautiful, expensive gift

[Chorus]
The offside trap says — we are one unit
The offside trap says — we move together
The offside trap says — step, now, together
One second later — the trap has either worked
Or it hasn't

[Bridge]
Chas watched the offside trap from the stands for forty years
Said — son, it's the most optimistic thing in football
A back four that trusts each other completely
That's rarer than the thing they're trying to stop

[Verse 3]
The linesman's flag is the verdict
Up — the trap worked
Down — someone hesitated
The hesitation is never the defender who hesitated
It's the whole idea of hesitation
Entering a system that had no room for it

[Outro]
The offside trap
The offside trap
That's my boy
